name: samovar-agent
description: Ask questions about your Samovar Data in plain language: guarded DuckDB SQL over your detail and mart layers, tables, charts and CSV/JSON/XLSX exports.

data_mode.title: Data: platform or demo
data_mode.description: platform reads your own data with the S3 key below. demo needs no key: it downloads a public snapshot of synthetic sample data (a made-up tea shop) to try the plugin.

s3_key_id.title: S3 key: Access Key ID
s3_key_id.description: A read-only S3 key an admin creates in the Samovar Data cabinet (S3 keys). Stored in the system keychain.

s3_secret.title: S3 key: Secret Access Key
s3_secret.description: The secret shown once with the key in the cabinet. Stored in the system keychain.

s3_bucket.title: S3 key: bucket
s3_bucket.description: The bucket shown with the key in the cabinet.

s3_endpoint.title: S3 key: endpoint
s3_endpoint.description: The endpoint shown with the key in the cabinet.

s3_region.title: S3 key: region
s3_region.description: The region shown with the key in the cabinet.

api_url.title: Platform URL
api_url.description: Samovar Data site; the descriptions of tables and columns are read from its public catalog (/api/v1/catalog), as in the cabinet.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where charts and exports are written, relative to the project folder.
